## Implementation Summary

All tasks T016-T020 have been completed successfully. The implementation includes:

### T016-T018: Type Definitions (lib/queue-types.ts)
- **QueueEntry**: Complete interface with all required fields (id, participantId, participantName, classroomId, raisedAt, position, isActive, role)
- **QueueState**: Complete interface with queue management fields (classroomId, entries, activeSpeaker, maxCapacity, lastUpdated, isActive)
- **ActiveSpeaker**: Complete interface for current speaker tracking (participantId, participantName, classroomId, calledAt, role)
- **Additional types**: QueueOperation, QueueEvent, and QueueError types for comprehensive queue system support

### T019: Utility Functions (lib/queue-utils.ts)
- **Creation functions**: createQueueEntry, createEmptyQueueState, createActiveSpeaker
- **Validation functions**: validateQueueEntry, validateQueueState, validateActiveSpeaker
- **Queue operations**: isParticipantInQueue, isQueueAtCapacity, getNextQueuePosition, findQueueEntry, updateQueuePositions

### T020: State Management (lib/queue-state.ts)
- **Core state management**: getQueueState, updateQueueState with validation
- **Queue operations**: addToQueue, removeFromQueue, callOnNextParticipant, clearActiveSpeaker, lowerAllHands
- **Participant lifecycle**: handleParticipantLeave, resetQueueState
- **Event system**: addQueueEventListener, removeQueueEventListener, broadcastQueueEvent
- **Daily.co integration**: Full integration with Daily.co participant events, automatic cleanup, error handling
